header: Praise collected from depot handover surveys
subheadline: Every consignment closes with a two-question survey at the receiving dock. These are unedited answers from the last quarter, including the ones that arrived with a complaint attached in the second field.

testimonials.quote: Driver called ahead at 05:40, backed onto bay 3 without being guided, and was off the yard in 18 minutes.
Shot-loaded and strapped properly. Four years of chipped tiles ended the week the dedicated trailer started running.
Fish left Tromsø at 18:00 and cleared Hamburg the next afternoon still at 1 °C. That is the whole job, done.
